articles.title: Sysco Halts All Mexican Lettuce Purchases as Cyclosporiasis Outbreak Kills Two
articles.excerpt: America's largest food distributor stops buying iceberg lettuce from Mexico entirely as the record-breaking parasitic outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases in Michigan alone.
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans who frequently consume salads at restaurants and fast-food chains should be aware of the ongoing lettuce contamination and take precautions with raw produce.

articles.title: Singhara Flour Cheela: The Fasting-Friendly Pancake Worth Making Year-Round
articles.excerpt: This crisp, protein-rich water chestnut flour pancake is a staple of Sawan Somwar fasting—and a gluten-free option that deserves a permanent place in the kitchen.
articles.image_caption: Singhara flour cheela, a crispy water chestnut flour pancake popular during Indian fasting days, can be enjoyed year-round as a nutritious snack.
articles.nri_angle: Singhara flour cheela connects diaspora families to Indian fasting traditions during Sawan, making observance possible with ingredients available through online Indian grocery retailers.

articles.title: Mumbai, Delhi and Jaipur Ranked Among World's Best Street Food Cities
articles.excerpt: Top chefs endorse global rankings as Mumbai's khau gallis and Delhi's Mughlai lanes earn international recognition from Time Out and TasteAtlas.
articles.nri_angle: Street food serves as a visceral connection to home for the diaspora; international validation may spur more Indian street food concepts abroad.

articles.title: Maharashtra Bans Analogue Paneer for One Year, Violators Face Jail Time
articles.excerpt: The state escalates from mandatory disclosure to an outright prohibition on fake paneer in all hotels and restaurants, with penalties including six months imprisonment.
articles.nri_angle: NRI visitors and the diaspora frequently consume paneer dishes when traveling to India; the ban ensures they receive genuine dairy products at restaurants.

articles.title: Biryani King Brings Punjabi Soul Food to Honolulu's Sheridan Street
articles.excerpt: A Pakistani-born chef's home-style cooking — from charcoal tandoor naan to oxtail biryani — is winning over Hawaiʻi's food scene and its desi community.
articles.image_caption: Biryani King, a new Punjabi restaurant on Honolulu's Sheridan Street, specialises in home-style biryani and North Indian cuisine
articles.nri_angle: A Pakistani Punjabi immigrant chef brings home-style cooking to Honolulu, filling a gap for the city's South Asian community
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bengaluru's Legendary MTR Is Opening in Sydney, Bringing Its Century-Old Dosas to Australia
articles.excerpt: Australia's assistant minister for multicultural affairs confirmed the 102-year-old Mavalli Tiffin Rooms will franchise in Sydney, adding to a growing list of international outposts.
articles.image_caption: MTR (Mavalli Tiffin Rooms), credited with inventing the rava idli, is opening a franchise in Sydney
articles.nri_angle: MTR's expansion to Sydney is a landmark moment for the large Indian-Australian community, many of whom have roots in South India and nostalgia for the restaurant's iconic dishes.

articles.title: Hyderabad Police Seize 25,000 Kg of Adulterated Spices Laced With Industrial Dyes
articles.excerpt: Raids on 13 spice processing units uncover fabric dye, synthetic colours, and talcum powder being used to make low-quality spices appear premium, part of a 140-day crackdown that has seized 246 tonnes of suspect food products.
articles.image_caption: Hyderabad police seized 25,000 kilograms of adulterated spices laced with industrial dyes in a crackdown on food safety violations.
articles.nri_angle: Indian spices are widely exported and sold globally. Adulteration in the supply chain raises questions about quality reaching diaspora consumers from London to Toronto to Sydney.

articles.title: India's Food Regulator Bars Dabur From Selling Products With Misleading '100%' Claims
articles.excerpt: FSSAI issues a prohibition order against Dabur India for labeling products as '100% Natural' and '100% Pure' without valid regulatory backing.
articles.nri_angle: Many NRIs regularly purchase Dabur products abroad, from honey to ghee. This ruling may force label changes on products sold in Indian grocery stores worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: FSSAI Bans Select Variants of Old Monk, Royal Challenge, and Bagpiper Over Artificial Flavouring
articles.excerpt: India’s food safety regulator ordered six whisky and rum brands off shelves after finding they violated rules on artificial flavouring in alcoholic beverages.
articles.image_caption: Old Monk rum is among the brands affected by FSSAI's ban on select variants containing artificial flavouring agents.
articles.nri_angle: Old Monk is an iconic brand among Indian diaspora communities worldwide; the ban raises questions about variants sold internationally.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Beyond the Rasgulla War: How Sun-Dried Mango Powers Odisha's Overlooked Cuisine
articles.excerpt: Ambula — salted, sun-dried mango — quietly anchors Odia cooking, lending a sour depth to curries, chutneys, and rice dishes that most Indian food lovers have never encountered.
articles.image_caption: Sun-dried mango, or ambula, is a staple of Odia cuisine used in curries, dals, and chutneys across Odisha.
articles.nri_angle: Introduces diaspora readers to a largely unknown regional Indian cuisine and a home-preservation technique — sun-drying mango — that is accessible even abroad.

articles.title: TUA & Synthe Brings Futuristic Cocktails and Pan-Asian Cuisine to Kolkata
articles.excerpt: A new drink-and-dine destination pairs Chef Vaibhav Bhargava's Pan-Asian menu with Ankur Chawla's decade-themed cocktail programme spanning 2030 to 2110.
articles.image_caption: TUA & Synthe in Kolkata serves futuristic cocktails with molecular mixology techniques alongside pan-Asian cuisine.
articles.nri_angle: Reflects Kolkata's evolving restaurant culture that now mirrors the fusion-forward dining diaspora Indians encounter in global cities
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sawan Somwar Is Here: Build a Satisfying Vrat Thali Without Onion or Garlic
articles.excerpt: The holy month of Shravan is underway, and today marks the first Monday fast. Here's how to put together a complete fasting thali anchored by a rich, no-onion paneer masala.
articles.image_caption: A traditional Sawan Somwar vrat thali includes sabudana, paneer, and fruit — all permissible during the Shravan fasting period.
articles.nri_angle: Guides diaspora families on sourcing vrat-friendly ingredients like kuttu flour, sendha namak (sold as Himalayan pink salt), and samak rice abroad, with practical tips for batch-prepping fasting meals around busy weekday schedules.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: How Strangers Are Feeding India's Exam Protesters Through Swiggy and Zomato
articles.excerpt: Anonymous supporters across India and abroad are using food delivery apps to send meals to student protesters, turning digital platforms into tools of solidarity.
articles.image_caption: Anonymous supporters have been ordering food through Swiggy and Zomato for delivery to exam-protest sites across Indian cities.
articles.nri_angle: Overseas Indians are using Swiggy and Zomato to send food to protest sites, turning delivery apps into a way for the diaspora to participate in civic movements from afar.

articles.title: Six Indian Cities Crack TasteAtlas Global Top 100, Mumbai Leads at Number Five
articles.excerpt: Mumbai's street food culture propelled it into the top five of TasteAtlas's 2025-26 ranking of the world's best food cities, while Amritsar, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and Chennai also earned spots on the 100-city list.
articles.nri_angle: The TasteAtlas ranking validates the culinary traditions diaspora communities carry with them, from Mumbai's vada pav to Chennai's filter coffee.

articles.title: Glasgow's Mister Singh's Hosted Team India, Then a Map on Its Napkins Sparked Outrage
articles.excerpt: Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain called out the iconic Punjabi restaurant after its printed napkins displayed an India map missing the entire Northeast region.
articles.nri_angle: The controversy highlights how diaspora-run restaurants abroad represent India's identity — and the emotional weight of accurate territorial depiction for overseas communities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: A Japanese Chef Spent 15 Years Perfecting Biryani. Tokyo's Michelin Guide Noticed.
articles.excerpt: Chef Takamasa Osawa's 10-seat biryani restaurant in Tokyo earned a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Tokyo 2026, making it only the second biryani-focused establishment globally to receive Michelin recognition.
articles.nri_angle: The Michelin recognition of a biryani restaurant in Tokyo highlights both the global spread of Indian cuisine and the absence of Michelin coverage from India's own culinary heartlands.

articles.title: Flipkart Enters Food Delivery With Low Commissions, Targeting Zomato-Swiggy Duopoly
articles.excerpt: Walmart-backed Flipkart plans a Bengaluru pilot with restaurant commissions as low as 10%, far below the 25-35% charged by incumbents, as India's $9 billion food delivery market heats up.
articles.nri_angle: Flipkart's low-commission entry could reshape food delivery pricing across India, affecting how diaspora families order food back home and signaling cheaper delivery for everyone.

articles.title: Lion Brewery Co Returns to India After Six Decades With Premium Beer Launch
articles.excerpt: The 1836-founded London brewery that helped pioneer India Pale Ale is entering Delhi's premium beer market with Copperdrop Spirits as its distribution partner.
articles.nri_angle: Indians in Singapore and the UK, where Lion Brewery Co already operates, will recognise the brand now arriving on home soil, completing an IPA homecoming with cultural resonance.

articles.title: Beetroot Cutlet Recipe: How To Make Crispy Tikki at Home
articles.excerpt: This vibrant beetroot tikki combines grated beets, mashed potato, and Indian spices into a crispy, protein-rich snack that works as an evening nibble, party starter, or even a burger patty.
articles.nri_angle: Beetroot cutlets are a simple way for diaspora cooks to recreate a beloved Indian street snack with ingredients available at any grocery store abroad.

articles.title: Rajasthan Challenges Gujarat's GI Tag on Cumin and Fennel
articles.excerpt: Farmers and scientists in Rajasthan are demanding revocation of Geographical Indication tags awarded to Unjha cumin and fennel, arguing Gujarat's largest spice market is a trading hub, not a production region.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora consumers who prize authentic Indian spices, the dispute raises questions about the true origin of cumin and fennel marketed under the Unjha label in international markets.

articles.title: From Garam Masala to Za'atar: The Ancient Spice Blends Modern Science Is Finally Validating
articles.excerpt: Centuries-old spice blends from India, Morocco, Ethiopia, and Japan are drawing clinical attention as researchers document their anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and gut-health benefits in a booming $4.75 billion global market.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora's traditional spice knowledge is being validated by modern science while driving commercial demand in global markets
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Moringa Goes Mainstream: How India's Humble Drumstick Tree Conquered the Global Superfood Market
articles.excerpt: The global moringa products market is projected to reach $15–25 billion by the mid-2030s, driven by demand for plant-based supplements and functional foods — with India supplying over 60% of the world's production.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora consumers find a familiar kitchen staple rebranded as a premium Western superfood, while diaspora entrepreneurs bridge Indian supply chains with branded consumer markets abroad.

articles.title: Makhana Kheer: A Creamy, Nutritious Dessert for Sawan Fasting Season
articles.excerpt: This simple fox nut kheer combines roasted makhana, full-fat milk, and saffron into a satisfying vrat-friendly treat rich in protein and fiber.

articles.title: California Lettuce Farmers Destroy Crops as Cyclospora Panic Tanks Demand

articles.title: Karnataka Restaurants Escalate Revolt Against Swiggy and Zomato With August 15 Ultimatum

articles.title: Randy's Donuts Opens Across From Beloved Stan's, Sparking Santa Clara's Doughnut Showdown

articles.title: Chipotle Raises Sales Outlook, Says Value Perception Is Improving

articles.title: How to Make Authentic Agra-Style Kesar Petha at Home in Three Steps
articles.excerpt: This saffron-scented ash gourd sweet, a signature delicacy of Agra, can be recreated in your own kitchen with just a handful of ingredients and a little patience.

articles.title: A Bowl of Maggi in an NYC Lunchbox Became a Celebration of Indian Food Culture

articles.title: Chilli Chipotle Chicken Brings Smoky Mexican Heat to an Indian Classic
articles.excerpt: The beloved Indo-Chinese chilli chicken gets a smoky Mexican makeover with chipotle peppers, blending two of the world's great spice traditions into one irresistible dish.

articles.title: Karnataka Mango Corporation to Build Dedicated Platform for Alphonso Domestic Sales
articles.excerpt: The Karnataka State Mango Development and Marketing Corporation plans to create a specialized digital platform to boost domestic marketing of Alphonso mangoes, building on its existing Karsiri portal infrastructure.
articles.nri_angle: NRI mango lovers who rely on seasonal Alphonso shipments could benefit from a more organized domestic supply chain that may eventually expand to international direct-to-consumer sales.

articles.title: Indian Biryani Restaurant's Mandarin-Language Video Goes Viral
articles.excerpt: The owner's daughter revealed the heartwarming story behind the restaurant's Chinese-language promotional video, which has racked up millions of views online.
articles.nri_angle: The video resonated with diaspora Indians who see it as an example of the entrepreneurial adaptability that characterises Indian food businesses worldwide, mirroring the experience of second-generation restaurant owners who bridge cultures.

articles.title: How Home Kitchens Became Hyderabad's Answer to Migrant Homesickness
articles.excerpt: A thriving ecosystem of tiffin services, home chefs, and cloud kitchens now serves regional cuisines from across India to the city's vast population of transplanted IT workers and students.

articles.title: Sanjay Dutt at 67: Six Meals a Day and a Weakness for Biryani
articles.excerpt: As Bollywood's 'Baba' marks his 67th birthday, a look at the disciplined six-meal diet that keeps him camera-ready — and the cheat-day indulgences he refuses to give up.

articles.title: Dahi Wale Tinde: The Yogurt Curry That Makes Humble Tinda Irresistible

articles.title: AI Calorie-Tracking Apps Undercount by Hundreds of Calories, NIH Study Finds
articles.excerpt: Photo-based nutrition apps underestimated meal calories by 250 to 345 on average, with fat miscounted by about 30 grams — and the errors are worse for mixed dishes common in Indian cuisine.
articles.image_caption: A new NIH study finds AI-powered calorie-tracking apps significantly undercount daily intake
articles.nri_angle: AI calorie-tracking apps perform worst on mixed Asian and Indian dishes like biryani and dal, making them unreliable for health-conscious diaspora users relying on these tools.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
